mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( post_id, user_id, text, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{userId}, #{text}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET text = #{text}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE comments SET deleted_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_ID, C.POST_ID, C.USER_ID, U.USERNAME USER_NAME, U.PROFILE_IMG AS PROFILE_IMAGE_URL, C.TEXT, C.CREATED_AT FROM COMMENTS C JOIN POSTS P ON P.POST_ID = C.POST_ID AND P.DELETE_AT IS NULL JOIN USERS U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND U.DELETE_AT IS NULL WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} AND C.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT, C.COMMENT_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
